mentions.name: recipe-extractor
mentions.description: A finetuned gemma-3-270M LLM that extracts recipes from blog posts, intended to run locally on an iPhone in a recipe-management app.
mentions.audience: Intended to run locally on an iPhone in a recipe-management app
mentions.source_excerpt:
I recently finetuned an LLM (gemma-3-270M) to extract recipes from blog posts.

My thoughts are that this is a perfect model for running locally on an iPhone in a recipe-management app.

Wrote a blog about what I learned while finetuning it https://vladr.com/blog/posts/finetuning-gemma3-to-extract-recipes/

And published the model on HF https://huggingface.co/v-rusu/recipe-extractor
